audience: compliance and onboarding teams who verify customer identity with Onfido

useCases.title: Check the verification checks of an applicant
useCases.text: The AI lists the checks run for an applicant and shows the status and result of each one, so you see which checks passed and which did not.

useCases.title: See which reports passed or failed in a check
useCases.text: The AI lists the reports inside a check, such as document, facial similarity or watchlist, and opens a report for its detailed breakdown and result.

useCases.title: Review the documents and photos of an applicant
useCases.text: The AI lists the identity documents, live photos and live videos of an applicant. It shows metadata only, not the files.

useCases.title: Follow Onfido Studio workflow runs
useCases.text: The AI lists workflow runs and opens one to read its status, output and task history. It does not start a run.

useCases.title: Add or correct an applicant record
useCases.text: The AI creates an applicant, or updates the details of an existing one. It runs no verification check.
